summary.instruction: Open the top drawer with arm A, pick up the plate with arm A and place it on the table, take the spoon with arm B and place it on the table, pick up the fork with arm B and hand it over to arm A, then place the fork, pick up the mug with arm B, pour water into the mug with arm A, then put the bottle back and place the mug on the table.
